footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Sep 30, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 16.2% to €2.1B in fiscal 2025 (ended Sep 30, 2025). Gross margin was 59.1%, versus 58.8% a year earlier, and operating income rose 30.5% to €550M, a 26.2% margin.
Net income rose 81.8% to €348M, or €1.87 per share. Operating cash flow was €384M and free cash flow €308M, versus €363M.
sources: Birkenstock Holding plc Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
